paite: Aw TOUPA kiang ah kipahthu hilh un; amah ahoih ngal a; azahngaihna tangtawn in a-om ding hi.
heading: BU NGANA / (Sam 107-150) / Pathian hoihna phatna
english: Give thanks to Yahweh, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

paite: TOUPA tatsate'n huai gen uhen, doumi khut a kipan atatkhiakte'n.
english: Let the redeemed by Yahweh say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

paite: Gam teng a kipan apikhawm a, suahlam leh tumlam, simlam leh mallam a kipan in.
english: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

paite: Gamdai a gamkeu lampi ah avakvak ua; tenna ding khua himhim amu kei uhi.
english: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

paite: Gilkial leh dangtak in ahinna uh agilsung uah abahta hi.
english: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

paite: Huaitak in abuaina uah TOUPA asam ua, ama'n alungkhamna uah ahumbit hi.
english: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

paite: Mihing tenna khua a apaitheihna ding un, lampi tangtak ah apikheta hi.
english: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

paite: Aw, mihingte'n TOUPA azahngaihna ziak leh mihing tate tung a athillamdang hihte ziak in phat teitei le u aw!
english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

paite: Ama'n ahinna un alunggulh mahmah in ataisak a, hinna gilkial avahsak hi.
english: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

paite: Mial nuai ah leh sihna lim a tu a, gimthuakna leh sikkhau a hente mahmah;
english: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,

paite: Pathian thute tung ah ahel ua, Tungnungpen lunggel angaihneu ziak un.
english: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

paite: Ama'n alungtang uh sepgimna in aminsakta a; apuk ua, panpihpa ding himhim a-om ngal kei a.
english: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.

paite: Abuaina uah TOUPA asam ua, ama'n abuaina ua kipan apikhia a, amangbatna ua pan ahondam hi.
english: Then they cried to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

paite: Mial nuai a kipan leh sihna lim a kipan apikhia a, ahenna uh asuktatsakta hi.
english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.

paite: Aw, mihingte'n TOUPA azahngaihna ziak in leh mihing tate tung a athillamdang hihte ziak in phat teitei le u aw!
english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

paite: Ama'n dal kongkhakte achimsak a, akalhna siktawnte ahihtanta ngal a.
english: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.

paite: Mihaite atatlekna ziak un leh, agitlouh satlouhnate uh ziak in akihihgim uhi.
english: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

paite: Ahinna un nek theih chiteng akih a; sihna kulh kongkhakte anaih uhi.
english: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

paite: Huaitak in abuaina uah TOUPA asam ua, ama'n amangbatna ua kipan in ahondam zel hi.
english: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.

paite: Athu asawlkhia a, amau adamsak hi, amanthatna ua kipan in ahumbit hi.
english: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

paite: Aw, mihingte'n TOUPA achit ziak leh mihing tate tung a athillamdang hihte ziak in phat teitei le uh aw!
english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

paite: Amau kipahthugen kithoihnate lan uhenla, athilhihte uh la sa in hilh uhen.
english: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

paite: Tuipi a long lian apaisuk a, tui zatak tung a nasemte'n.
english: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,

paite: Huaite'n TOUPA thilhihte leh tui thupi a athillamdang hihte amu uhi.
english: these see Yahweh’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.

paite: Ama'n thu apia a, huihpi anungsak a, huai in atuikihotte asangsak hi.
english: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

paite: Van lam ah septouh in a-om ua, tui thukpi ah atumsuk nawn zel uhi; mangbatna ziak in ahinna uh azulbei hi.
english: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

paite: Zukham bang in asawi hoihoi ua, atuan loklok ua, omdan ding hun lel athei kei nak uhi.
english: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

paite: Huan abuaina uah TOUPA asam ua, ama'n amangbatna ua kipan in api hi.
english: Then they cry to Yahweh in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

paite: Huihpi adaisak duam a, huchi in atuikihotte adai uhi.
english: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

paite: Huan adaih tak ziak in akipak ua; huchi in ama'n a-omna ding uh longkhawlna ah apitung hi.
english: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

paite: Aw, mihingte'n TOUPA achit ziak leh, mihing tate tung a athillamdang hihte ziak in phat mahmah le uh aw!
english: Let them praise Yahweh for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!

paite: Amau mite kikhopna ah amah phat uhenla, upate tutna ah phat uhen.
english: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

paite: Ama'n luipite gamdai asuaksak a, tui nakte leng lei keu asuaksak hi.
english: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

paite: Gam hoih gamsia asuaksak zel, asung a omte genhak ziak in.
english: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

paite: Gamdai dilmun asuaksak zel a, gamkeu leng tui nak asuaksak hi.
english: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

paite: Huai ah gilkialte a-omsak a, tenna ding khua abawl uhi.
english: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

paite: Loute anei ua, grephuante abawl ua, agah hong pungte amuhtheihna ding un.
english: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

paite: Amau avualzawl a, nakpitak a hihpun in a-om ua; agante uh kiam aphal kei hi.
english: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.

paite: Huan nuaisiah, gimthuakna, lungkhamna ziak in akiam hiaihiai ua, akun ngiungiau lel uhi.
english: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

paite: Ama'n miliante tung ah muhsitna asungbua a, gamdai, lampi omlouhna ah avakvaisak hi.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

paite: Himahleh gentheite gimthuakna a kipan in mun sang ah akhatou hi, ganhon bang in inkuanpihte asiamsak hi.
english: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

paite: Midiktatte'n huai mu in akipak ding uh; thulimlouhna tengteng in akam ahum ding hi.
english: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.

paite: Kuapeuh apil in huaite akemhoih ding ua, TOUPA zahngaihnate angaihtuah ding uhi.
english: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.
